summary: Each ansible-core release is tagged vX.Y.Z from its stable branch, and since 2.13 the GitHub auto-generated tarball of the tag is the official release artifact.
questions: How do I get the exact source code for a given ansible-core release?
What is the official release artifact for ansible-core?

answer_card.title: ansible-core release tags
answer_card.answer_md: Each release is tagged `vX.Y.Z` on the release commit in `stable-X.Y`. Since **ansible-core 2.13**, the GitHub auto-generated tarball of that tag is the official canonical release artifact.
